content.user_title: Design an Email List Growth Plan
content.value_statement: Growing an email list without a clear acquisition and consent strategy can attract low-quality subscribers. This skill designs channels, incentives, opt-in flows, referrals, and measurable targets.
actual_capabilities: Defines measurable subscriber growth, cost-per-opt-in, confirmation, and early-engagement targets.
Reviews current acquisition using user-provided signup sources, list size, and growth history.
Proposes honest lead magnets and signup incentives matched to the audience and email offer.
Plans owned, earned, and paid acquisition channels with volume and consent-quality tradeoffs.
Specifies single or double opt-in flows and the consent evidence to capture.
Designs referral mechanics, attribution, quality controls, and structured handoffs to related skills.
limitations: Does not build signup pages, popups, forms, or confirmation email copy.
Does not create authoritative consent records or change suppression status.
Provides compliance guidance, not jurisdiction-specific legal advice.
Relies on supplied data and does not invent industry benchmarks or baselines.

use_cases.title: Launch a newsletter list
use_cases.description: Create an acquisition plan, lead magnet, opt-in flow, referral loop, and growth targets for a new newsletter.

use_cases.title: Improve subscriber quality
use_cases.description: Compare current channels and redesign signup incentives around consent quality, confirmation rate, and early engagement.

use_cases.title: Specify a compliant capture flow
use_cases.description: Document consent evidence, confirmation steps, jurisdiction caveats, and handoff requirements before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic growth plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan email list growth for [audience]. My offer is [offer], current signup source is [source], and target is [goal] by [date].
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a clear audience, offer, source, and measurable goal.

prompt_templates.title: Design a lead magnet
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose three honest lead magnets for [audience] and [offer]. Compare relevance, production effort, consent quality, and expected acquisition channels.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose an incentive that attracts subscribers likely to value future emails.

prompt_templates.title: Specify the opt-in flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a consent-aware opt-in flow for [jurisdiction]. Compare single and double opt-in, then list the evidence to capture at signup.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an implementation specification for marketing operations and compliance review.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize the full growth system
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this signup history: [data]. Build a channel portfolio, referral loop, quality controls, cohort metrics, experiment priorities, and downstream handoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Develop an advanced growth program using measured acquisition and engagement data.

output_examples.input: Grow a weekly analytics newsletter from 2,000 to 3,000 subscribers in six months.
output: Lead magnet: a practical dashboard audit checklist aligned with weekly newsletter topics.
Channels: evergreen articles, partner webinars, product community posts, and an existing-subscriber referral test.
Primary target: 167 net new subscribers monthly, labeled as calculated from the user goal.
Quality checks: confirmation rate, early engagement, unsubscribe rate, and source-level cost per opt-in.

output_examples.input: Design an EU signup flow for a free course and compare single versus double opt-in.
output_examples.output: Recommend double opt-in as a quality practice, document the confirmation sequence, and capture timestamp, source, wording, and lawful basis. Request legal review before launch.

output_examples.input: Create a referral loop for a 10,000-subscriber product newsletter.
output: Offer a useful digital bonus after a verified referral threshold.
Use unique share links with source attribution and confirmation status.
Exclude duplicate, suppressed, and unconfirmed referrals from rewards.
Measure referral participation, confirmed referrals, early engagement, and incentive cost.

best_practices: Provide the audience, offer, jurisdiction, current signup source, list size, and measured growth history.
Label every target as calculated, estimated, measured, or user-provided.
Review consent requirements with qualified counsel and confirm before saving workflow artifacts.
anti_patterns: Do not buy lists, reacquire suppressed contacts, or reward unconfirmed referrals.
Do not use misleading free claims or incentives unrelated to future email content.
Do not treat double opt-in as universally required or invent a universal conversion benchmark.

faq.question: Does this skill build signup forms or landing pages?
faq.answer: No. It produces the strategy and capture-flow specification for a separate implementation workflow.

faq.question: Can it recommend single or double opt-in?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares both approaches using jurisdiction, list quality, deliverability, and available consent evidence.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides general compliance guidance and recommends qualified legal review for jurisdiction-specific requirements.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your audience, offer, jurisdiction, signup sources, list size, growth history, conversion data, and target.

faq.question: Can it design a referral program?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines incentives, sharing mechanics, attribution, quality safeguards, and metrics. Detailed financial modeling belongs in a monetization workflow.

faq.question: Will it create consent records?
faq.answer: No. It specifies required evidence and prepares a controlled handoff to the consent registry workflow.
